description: The finished report. Call it first with failedOnly: true and view: "digest": only the failed pages, each with its issues, diff percentage and largest regions, and a text line per page; summary covers every page. check_page and diff_deploy return the first regressed region's image; get_screenshot (?surface=full) fetches a region by filename. Without view, results are { path, status, failedChecks }; responseFormat: "detailed" returns per-check fields. offset and limit page through results (default 50, at most 5000; nextOffset is next); limit: 1 returns the summary alone; includeText: true adds the plain-text report. A change whose flakyShare is at least 0.5 is likely the page moving on its own: mask its fingerprint's element (visual.masks), not a regression. Call wait_for_comparison first. Free.

failedOnly.description: Only failed pages in results, total, nextOffset and text; summary still covers every page.

includeText.description: Also put the text block in structuredContent.text.

jobId.description: Returned at job creation, e.g. web-1a2b3c.

jobToken.description: Returned at job creation; optional when the HTTP headers carry the key that paid the job.

limit.description: Page results to return (at most 5000; default 1000 on REST, 50 over MCP).

offset.description: Index of the first page result to return (default 0).

responseFormat.description: concise (default): each result is { path, status, failedChecks }, plus snapshots when a side came from one; detailed: every per-check field, diff and screenshot name.

view.description: full (default): every page result with its diffs, screenshots and text; digest: one small object per page (status, failed checks, issues, diff percentage), no text.
